title: Ukrainian sole proprietor (FOP) on the simplified taxation system
description: Context for decisions on single-tax group eligibility and monthly single-tax / military-levy payments (Tax Code of Ukraine, art. 291.4, 293).

requestedGroup.description: Single-tax group the FOP applies or wants to apply (1, 2 or 3).

annualIncome.description: Income for the calendar (reporting) year, UAH.

monthlyIncome.description: Income for the month the payments are calculated for, UAH.

employeesCount.description: Maximum number of hired employees at the same time.

activityType.description: Main activity: retail sale from market stalls, household services to the population, other services, sale of goods, production, restaurant business.

businessClients.description: True if the FOP sells goods or provides services to legal entities or other FOPs (any taxation system).

servicesToGeneralSystemClients.description: True if the FOP provides services to legal entities or FOPs that are NOT single-tax payers (general taxation system).

vatPayer.description: True if the FOP is registered as a VAT payer.
